content: We asses our model performance relative to GARCH(1,1) using standard loss metrics (MSE and MAE) and the regression-based accuracy specified in eq:regressionloss and measured in terms of the coefficient of determination $R^2$ . In addition, we evaluate our model across two different volatility proxies: Garman-Klass ( $\widehat{\sigma _{GK}}$ ) (eq:volgk) and Parkinson ( $\widehat{\sigma _{PK}}$ ) (eq:volpk). We note that, as reviewed in sub:evalution, these two volatility proxies are statically efficient and proper estimators of the next day volatility.
